title: Retrieval Routes
description: Sidecar schema validating retrieval-routes.json. Maps each literature source class (primary_literature, conference_proceedings, tool_documentation) to the concrete hosts and optional domain suffixes the agent may fetch from. Used to build the survey atom egress allowlist and to bound the agent literature fetcher.

hosts.description: Exact hostnames the agent may fetch from for this class.

domainSuffixes.description: Optional domain suffixes (e.g. .readthedocs.io) bounding a subdomain family.
